heard: Israel cried out to the Lord in distress Oppressed for twenty years by iron chariots Sisera commanded the army of Jebin Cruelty ruled from Hazor to the plain Deborah called bar up to Montauk Ten thousand men from Zebulun and Naphtali The Lord would draw Sisera to Kishon And give the enemy into their hand And Sisera fled on foot in the night to the tent of Jehovah.
